parameters.name: mask_source
parameters.label: Vegetation Mask Source
parameters.description: 'auto' derives the mask from the input image with an RGB vegetation index; 'file' reads the mask_path produced by the Module 4 plugin.

parameters.name: mask_path
parameters.label: Vegetation Mask File
parameters.description: Absolute path to a Module 4 vegetation mask PNG (white = vegetation). Required when mask_source is 'file'.

parameters.name: method
parameters.label: Vegetation Index Method
parameters.description: Index used to derive the mask when mask_source is 'auto'.

parameters.name: threshold_value
parameters.label: Detection Threshold
parameters.description: Pixels with an index above this value count as vegetation (auto mask only). Suggested starts: ExG 0.10, ExR 0.00, VARI 0.03.

parameters.name: gsd_m
parameters.label: Ground Sample Distance
parameters.description: Metres per pixel. 0 derives it from the image metadata (altitude and focal length); without either, area metrics are omitted.

parameters.name: grid_size
parameters.label: Zonation Grid Size
parameters.description: Zonation divides the mask into grid_size x grid_size cells and reports coverage per cell.

parameters.name: low_threshold
parameters.label: Low Coverage Limit
parameters.description: Coverage percentage at or below this value is classified as 'low'.

parameters.name: medium_threshold
parameters.label: Medium Coverage Limit
parameters.description: Coverage percentage at or below this value (but above the low limit) is 'medium'; anything higher is 'high'.

parameters.name: plots
parameters.label: Plots (JSON)
parameters.description: Optional JSON array of plots for per-plot coverage, e.g. [{"plot_id":"A","polygon":[[lon,lat],...]}]. Polygon coordinates are WGS84 lon/lat rings.
